svg.aria-label: GreenBranch deployment on an Android phone. A push to main runs vercel-deploy.yaml for frontend changes, which builds and deploys the Next.js frontend to Vercel, and phone-deploy.yaml for backend changes, which checks both backends and then runs deploy.sh on the phone over SSH through Cloudflare Access. On the phone, Debian runs inside Termux with proot-distro, and PM2 runs server-ai, server-runner, redis-server and cloudflared. cloudflared dials out to Cloudflare, so the phone needs no public IP: Cloudflare routes HTTPS and WebSocket traffic to server-ai on port 8000 and SSH to Termux's sshd on port 8022. server-ai calls the Groq API and GitHub; server-runner clones and pushes with git.
svg.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
